scope: source-checkout native complex models; not a package release or complete application migration
execution: Rust/wgtime native CPU, no Python model-compute callbacks

tests.native_complex_behavior: 14 real-service tests; seven restored networks; Any2Any four-layer Transformer, request GRU, seeded dropout, notebook, fixed/learned thinking, all-parameter SGD
tests.generation: ELF and HNet autoregressive byte generation and stop match Torch
tests.default_geometry: width128/capacity2048 generators; RGB width64/depth16 forward and two Adam steps, geometry/depth8 roundtrip; Any2Any width128/sequence_limit4096 weight import, learned-budget forward and live depth/input rebinding
tests.shared_wgt_source: All seven definitions run via explicit Torch from_ir with identical parameters and logical outputs; Any2Any replays identical dropout masks
tests.wheel: 19 packaged model.wgt files; native Any2Any host/source byte-identical to checkout
tests.formatting_note: CLI format cannot bind unbound dimensions in the external Any2Any template; explicit bound compilation and real execution verified

limitations: attention uses N-slot selection masks, not compact K detail storage
Any2Any mean-request/semantic-chunk/BPE paths, standalone GreenObserver/structure/X86World hosts remain explicit Torch; RGB streaming state API not ported
native unified optimizer checkpoint persistence not implemented
Any2Any native work/port/tape limits remain; full 256-position/multichunk training not inferred from short-input acceptance
Learned depth uses hard no-gradient selection; AD may evaluate masked red candidates up to bound
